snippet.title: Arms of God - Demo Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Enjoy this (mostly) cinematic new trailer for Arms of God, the upcoming solo-developed fantasy/sci-fi roguelite autoshooter with Doom-y vibes. A playable demo is available on Steam today. Check it out if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3100310/Arms_of_God/
